note: Every candidate, company, role, and rating in this corpus is invented. It exists so the benchmark harness, its thresholds, and its record can be exercised end to end before the recruiter's real frozen corpus arrives, and it is not a substitute for that corpus. No real candidate information appears in this repository. Structured labels use the product's own field vocabulary from internal/profile/taxonomy.go, and state only what each listing says in words: a benchmark that demands inference is measuring something the source never asked for. Every role is rated for every scenario: rating a subset left the rest counting as not plausible by default, and left one scenario with two plausible roles in twenty, where three of the top five cannot be met however good the ranking is.

# Candidate profile — invented

## Summary

Backend and platform engineer, seven years. Based in Melbourne, looking for
hybrid work, permanent, expecting around AUD 180,000 base.

## Experience

**Senior platform engineer, Kestrel Freight (2022–present)**
Ran the platform team's shared services in Go. Moved the order pipeline to a
multi-region deployment across two Australian regions, cutting failover time
from twenty minutes to under two. Owned the on-call rotation and the incident
review process. Introduced structured logging and tracing across eleven
services.

**Backend engineer, Kestrel Freight (2019–2022)**
Built and maintained REST and gRPC services in Go against PostgreSQL. Wrote the
embedded SQLite cache used by the field application, including its migration
tooling. Reduced p95 latency on the quoting endpoint from 900 ms to 120 ms.

**Software engineer, Marlow Systems (2017–2019)**
Python and Go services for logistics scheduling. Maintained the CI pipeline and
the deployment scripts.

## Skills

Go, SQLite, PostgreSQL, gRPC, Kubernetes, Terraform, observability and tracing,
incident response, multi-region architecture, technical mentoring.

warehouse design, stakeholder communication.

# Candidate profile — invented

## Summary

Frontend engineer, six years, with a focus on accessibility. Sydney, hybrid,

# Candidate profile — invented

## Summary

Site reliability engineer, eight years in operations. Brisbane, hybrid,

**Site reliability engineer, Corella Health (2021–present)**
Ran Kubernetes clusters carrying a patient-facing platform. Owned alerting in

Embedded engineer, nine years in industrial equipment. Perth, onsite,

**Senior embedded engineer, Redgum Mining Tech (2020–present)**
Firmware in C for conveyor control units with hard real-time deadlines. Wrote

C firmware for sensor modules. Built the hardware-in-the-loop test rig used for
